text:
Maya: Heads-up — ACME is seeing their long system prompts get cut off after our canary rolled last night. They say instructions that used to persist (8k+ prompt) now disappear mid-conversation. :frowning:
Eric: ack. Do we have the canary id / deploy time?
Maya: deploy-bot shows canary 2024-11-09T02:12Z -> canary-id c-482. Support ticket #12482. Customer sent a minimal repro.
Lia: can you paste the repro?
Maya: here — simplified curl they sent: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","prompt":"<system>INSTRUCTIONS...VERY LONG...</system>\n<user>Do X</user>","max_tokens":512}'``` They say after ~3000 tokens of history the model starts ignoring the <system> block.
Sam: any 429/500s reported? Could be partial KV cache eviction causing coherence drop.
Maya: no 5xx, just wrong behavior. We see steady 200s but output loses instruction-following.
support-bot: Ticket 12482 created and linked to this thread.
Eric: quick mitigation — tell customer to pin to previous model variant (redwood-large-v1@2024-10-30) while we investigate. Also request request_id from their failing calls.
Maya: asked for full request_ids and a minimal payload that reproduces deterministically. Customer returned two ids: r_01f8 and r_01f9.
Lia: adding repro steps for SRE: 1) use the exact system prompt they included (we have it in the ticket), 2) run a 4k+ context session with repeated user turns until behavior diverges, 3) capture server-side request_id from response header `x-request-id`.
Sam: grabbing traces now. If this is KV eviction policy change in canary, traces should show earlier cache truncation or changed cache-keying.
deploy-bot: Canary c-482 deployed by @jen at 2024-11-09T02:12Z. Rolling back to c-460 is possible.
Eric: do we have any config changes in the canary that could affect prefix preservation? (batching, kv window, quant profile)
Lia: canary included a kernel scheduling tweak + a micro change to memory compaction for KV cache when host memory pressure > 78%. Might be related.
Maya: customer is upset — says this breaks product workflows, could be billing-impacting. They've asked for ETA on fix / rollback.
Sam: initial trace shows earlier-than-expected KV purge at token ~3300 for sessions that historically kept 8k. I'm uploading full trace to the incident bucket (s3://redwood-incidents/12482/traces/).
Eric: thanks. For now: (1) advise customer to pin older variant (as Lia suggested), (2) open a rollback request for canary c-482 and pause further rollouts, (3) SRE to triage KV purge logic and revert the compaction threshold if repro confirmed.
Maya: telling customer the mitigation steps and that we're investigating. Will DM them rollback instructions if we proceed.
Sam: capturing a repro run now and will attach logs + `x-request-id`. If we confirm the canary is the cause I'll prod for rollback.
Eric: also add a short test to the canary pipeline that runs long-system-prompt sessions (8k) to catch this in future.
Maya: noted. I'll update ticket 12482 with the mitigation and current actions. Thanks :thumbsup:
Lia: if rollback happens, QA should run the customer's repro to confirm resolution before close.
Maya: closing loop here — will post follow-ups when we have traces/rollback status.
